_what: U.S. federal budget surplus or deficit by fiscal year, nominal dollars.
_built: 2026-10-31 by Josh (flashpoint desk), sourced not authored.
_convention: OMB sign convention: a NEGATIVE value is a deficit, a POSITIVE value is a surplus.

_sources.name: FRED series FYFSD, Federal Surplus or Deficit [-], annual fiscal year, millions of dollars (source agency: U.S. Office of Management and Budget; FRED series last updated 2026-10-28). PRIMARY SOURCE FOR EVERY VALUE IN "series". Already in millions of dollars; no unit conversion applied. FRED dates each annual observation at the fiscal year end (1901-06-30 = FY1901, 2026-09-30 = FY2026); those dates were mapped to integer fiscal years.

OMB Historical Tables landing page, Office of Management and Budget. Used only to locate the canonical Table 1.1 asset (hist01z1_fy2027.xlsx). The .xlsx itself could NOT be read in this environment, so no value in this file comes from it.
_sources.covers: asset discovery only; no data extracted

_sources.name: Historical Tables, Budget of the U.S. Government, Fiscal Year 2006, Table 1.1, HTML rendering published by GPO/govinfo. CROSS-CHECK ONLY. Also the authority for the statement that OMB publishes no annual pre-1901 figures, only the aggregates 1789-1849 = +70 and 1850-1900 = -991.

U.S. Treasury FiscalData API, Monthly Treasury Statement Table 1. CROSS-CHECK ONLY. Reported in whole dollars with the opposite sign convention (a positive amount is a deficit); divided by 1,000,000 and sign-flipped before comparison.

FRED series MTSDS133FMS, Federal Surplus or Deficit [-], monthly, millions of dollars (source agency: U.S. Department of the Treasury, Fiscal Service, Monthly Treasury Statement). CROSS-CHECK ONLY, and an imperfect one: summing its twelve months does not exactly reproduce the OMB annual total (see _crosschecked).

_coverage: Every fiscal year from FY1901 through FY2026 is present, 126 consecutive entries with no gaps. Nothing before FY1901 is included: the canonical OMB Table 1.1 does not publish annual figures for 1789-1900, only two multi-decade aggregates (1789-1849 = +70 million, 1850-1900 = -991 million), so individual years such as 1865 could not be sourced and were omitted rather than estimated. The July-September 1976 transition quarter (-14,744 million, created when the fiscal year moved from a June 30 to a September 30 end) is also omitted because it is not a fiscal year and has no integer fiscal-year label; FY1976 and FY1977 are both present and neither includes it.
_crosschecked: FY1901 (+63), FY1902 (+77) and FY1903 (+45): exact match between FRED FYFSD and GPO/govinfo Table 1.1 from the FY2006 Historical Tables.
FY1919 (-13,363): exact match between FRED FYFSD and GPO/govinfo Table 1.1, FY2006 Historical Tables.
FY1943 (-54,554): exact match between FRED FYFSD and GPO/govinfo Table 1.1, FY2006 Historical Tables.
FY1968 (-25,161) and FY1976 (-73,732): exact match between FRED FYFSD and GPO/govinfo Table 1.1, FY2006 Historical Tables.

FY1983 (-207,802): exact match between FRED FYFSD and GPO/govinfo Table 1.1, FY2006 Historical Tables. NOTE: summing the twelve Treasury Monthly Treasury Statement months Oct-1982 through Sep-1983 from FRED MTSDS133FMS gives -195,354, which is 12,448 million off. The as-reported monthly statements do not reconcile to the revised annual budget accounts for this era, so the monthly sum was treated as non-authoritative and did not override the two agreeing annual sources.

FY2009 (-1,412,688): confirmed only by FRED FYFSD / OMB. Summing the twelve Treasury MTS months Oct-2008 through Sep-2009 from FRED MTSDS133FMS gives -1,415,725, which corroborates to within 3,037 million (0.2%) but is not an exact match. NOT independently confirmed to the dollar.
FY2020 (-3,131,917.2488882998): exact match. Treasury FiscalData MTS Table 1, statement dated 2020-09-30, Year-to-Date deficit 3,131,917,248,888.30 dollars = 3,131,917.2488883 million.

FY2026 (-1,992,473.2243524201): exact match. Treasury FiscalData MTS Table 1, statement dated 2026-09-30, Year-to-Date deficit 1,992,473,224,352.42 dollars. This also confirms FY2026 is a Treasury actual from the final Monthly Treasury Statement, not a budget estimate.

FY2025 (-1,775,357.2807338701): near match, NOT exact. The FY2025 comparative column of the September 2026 Treasury statement reads 1,775,369,189,818.35 dollars = 1,775,369.1898 million, which is 11.9 million higher than the value in this file. The difference is a prior-year restatement; the FRED/OMB figure was kept for consistency with the rest of the series.

FY1998 (+69,270), FY2000 (+236,241) and FY2004 (-412,727): these are the CURRENT OMB figures and they deliberately differ from the FY2006 Historical Tables, which showed +69,200, +236,151 and -412,144. The older edition was superseded by later OMB revisions, so the current values were kept. This confirms the two sources are consistent in era but not in vintage.
FY1865 and all other pre-1901 landmark years: COULD NOT BE CROSS-CHECKED because no annual pre-1901 value was obtained from any source; those years are absent from the series entirely.
